title: Urgent: Your Microsoft 365 Account Will Be Disabled Within 24 Hours
text:
Subject: URGENT: Immediate Action Required - Microsoft 365 Security Alert

Dear User,

We detected unauthorized access to your Microsoft 365 workspace. Your account has been temporarily restricted due to suspicious activity. Failure to comply within 24 hours will result in permanent account termination.

Please verify your identity immediately by clicking below:
http://login.microsoft365.verify-portal-security.com/auth/login

IT Support Department
Security & Compliance Team

title: Overdue Wire Transfer / Banking Security Notice
text:
Subject: Critical Notice: Confirm Your Banking Details for Pending Wire Transfer

Your account has a pending wire transfer refund of $2,450.00. To release the funds, please confirm your identity, social security number, and PIN code immediately.

Click here to update your billing details:
http://192.168.1.50:8443/online-banking/confirm_details.php

title: Quarterly Engineering Team Sync Notes
text:
